unitTitle: Describing Location - Relative Pronouns - Relative Adverbs - Some/Any/No

pairsWith.noteUz: Joylashuv (Ispaniya xaritasi), who/which bilan ta'rif berish mashqlari.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 12-UNIT MAShQLAR (59-bet, PDF 58). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '12'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Describing Location':
1) 'Look at the map and using the phrases in the list, say where the following cities/towns are located, as in the example.' Ro'yxat: on the east coast of, in the north-west of, on the south coast of, on the north-east coast of, in the heart of, in the south-west of, on the south-east coast of. XARITA: Ispaniya (Portugaliya binafsha): Oviedo (shimoli-g'arbda), Bilbao (shimoli-sharqiy qirg'oq), Madrid (markaz), Barcelona (sharqiy qirg'oq), Valencia (janubi-sharqiy qirg'oq), Seville (janubi-g'arb), Malaga (janubiy qirg'oq). 1 Valencia is located on the south-east coast of Spain. 2 Madrid 3 Seville 4 Oviedo 5 Bilbao 6 Malaga 7 Barcelona
'Relative Pronouns/Adverbs':
2) 'First match the jobs to the pictures, then use the prompts to make sentences with who, as in the example.' teacher, painter, photographer, tailor, doctor, carpenter. SURATLAR: 1 doska oldida erkak - teacher; 2 stetoskopli ayol; 3 fotoapparatli odam; 4 rasm chizayotgan erkak; 5 yog'och ishlayotgan erkak; 6 kostyum o'lchayotgan erkak. Ko'rsatmalar: teach children, take care of sick people, paint portraits, take pictures, makes clothes, make things from wood. 1 A teacher is someone who teaches children.

O'NG USTUN:
3) 'Match the objects to their uses and then make sentences using which, as in the example.' a) shelters you from the rain b) cuts things c) you hang clothes on d) puts out fire e) you take pictures with f) keeps you cool g) you measure things with h) you eat your soup with. RASMLAR: camera = e; umbrella; fire extinguisher; spoon; fan; tape measure; a pair of scissors; hanger. 1 A camera is something which you take pictures with.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '59'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the map and using the phrases in the list, say where the following cities/towns are located, as in the example. Phrases: on the east coast of, in the north-west of, on the south coast of, on the north-east coast of, in the heart of, in the south-west of, on the south-east coast of. Map of Spain: Oviedo (north-west), Bilbao (north-east coast), Madrid (centre), Barcelona (east coast), Valencia (south-east coast), Seville (south-west), Malaga (south coast). 1 Valencia is located on the south-east coast of Spain. 2 Madrid 3 Seville 4 Oviedo 5 Bilbao 6 Malaga 7 Barcelona
exercises.instructionUz: Xaritaga qarang va ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan quyidagi shaharlar qayerda joylashganini ayting, namunadagidek. Iboralar: on the east coast of, in the north-west of, on the south coast of, on the north-east coast of, in the heart of, in the south-west of, on the south-east coast of. Ispaniya xaritasi: Oviedo (shimoli-g'arb), Bilbao (shimoli-sharqiy qirg'oq), Madrid (markaz), Barcelona (sharqiy qirg'oq), Valencia (janubi-sharqiy qirg'oq), Seville (janubi-g'arb), Malaga (janubiy qirg'oq). 1 Valensiya Ispaniyaning janubi-sharqiy qirg'og'ida joylashgan. 2 Madrid 3 Seville 4 Oviedo 5 Bilbao 6 Malaga 7 Barcelona
exercises.explanationUz:
ISPANIYA XARITASI.

  1 Valencia - on the south-east
    coast of (NAMUNA)
  2 Madrid - in the heart of
    (markaz)
  3 Seville - in the south-west of
    (qirg'oqda emas)
  4 Oviedo - in the north-west of
  5 Bilbao - on the north-east
    coast of
  6 Malaga - on the south coast of
  7 Barcelona - on the east coast
    of

  ⚠ Qirg'oqdagi shahar → ON the
  ... COAST; ichkaridagi → IN the
  ... OF.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 Valencia is located on the south-east coast of Spain.
modelAnswers: 1 Valencia is located on the south-east coast of Spain.
2 Madrid is located in the heart of Spain.
3 Seville is located in the south-west of Spain.
4 Oviedo is located in the north-west of Spain.
5 Bilbao is located on the north-east coast of Spain.
6 Malaga is located on the south coast of Spain.
7 Barcelona is located on the east coast of Spain.

exercises.instructionEn: First match the jobs to the pictures, then use the prompts to make sentences with who, as in the example. Jobs: teacher, painter, photographer, tailor, doctor, carpenter. Pictures: 1 man at a blackboard; 2 woman with a stethoscope; 3 person with a camera; 4 man painting; 5 man working with wood; 6 man measuring a suit. Prompts: teach children, take care of sick people, paint portraits, take pictures, make clothes, make things from wood. 1 A teacher is someone who teaches children.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval kasblarni rasmlarga moslang, so'ng ko'rsatmalar bilan who orqali gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. Kasblar: teacher, painter, photographer, tailor, doctor, carpenter. Rasmlar: 1 doska oldidagi erkak; 2 stetoskopli ayol; 3 fotoapparatli odam; 4 rasm chizayotgan erkak; 5 yog'och ishlayotgan erkak; 6 kostyum o'lchayotgan erkak. Ko'rsatmalar: teach children, take care of sick people, paint portraits, take pictures, make clothes, make things from wood. 1 O'qituvchi - bolalarni o'qitadigan odam.
exercises.explanationUz:
KASB TA'RIFI - SOMEONE WHO.

  1 teacher → teaches children
  2 doctor → takes care of sick
    people
  3 photographer → takes pictures
  4 painter → paints portraits
  5 carpenter → makes things from
    wood
  6 tailor → makes clothes

  ⚠ 'someone who' + 3-shaxs -s.


⚠ 'A TAILOR':

  = tikuvchi (erkaklar kiyimi).


⚠ 'A CARPENTER':

  = duradgor.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 A teacher is someone who teaches children.
modelAnswers: 1 A teacher is someone who teaches children.
2 A doctor is someone who takes care of sick people.
3 A photographer is someone who takes pictures.
4 A painter is someone who paints portraits.
5 A carpenter is someone who makes things from wood.
6 A tailor is someone who makes clothes.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the objects to their uses and then make sentences using which, as in the example. Objects: camera, umbrella, fire extinguisher, spoon, fan, tape measure, a pair of scissors, hanger. Uses: a) shelters you from the rain b) cuts things c) you hang clothes on d) puts out fire e) you take pictures with f) keeps you cool g) you measure things with h) you eat your soup with. 1 A camera is something which you take pictures with.
exercises.instructionUz: Narsalarni ishlatilishiga moslang va which bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. Narsalar: fotoapparat, soyabon, o't o'chirgich, qoshiq, ventilyator, o'lchov lentasi, qaychi, ilgich. Ishlatilishi: a) yomg'irdan himoya qiladi b) narsalarni kesadi c) kiyim osasiz d) olovni o'chiradi e) suratga olasiz f) salqin qiladi g) o'lchaysiz h) sho'rva ichasiz. 1 Fotoapparat - suratga oladigan narsa.
exercises.explanationUz:
NARSA TA'RIFI - SOMETHING WHICH.

  1 camera - e (take pictures
    with)
  2 umbrella - a (shelters from
    rain)
  3 fire extinguisher - d (puts
    out fire)
  4 spoon - h (eat soup with)
  5 fan - f (keeps you cool)
  6 tape measure - g (measure
    with)
  7 scissors - b (cuts things)
  8 hanger - c (hang clothes on)

  ⚠ Predlog gap OXIRIDA qoladi:
  'which you take pictures WITH'.


⚠ 'A FIRE EXTINGUISHER':

  = o't o'chirgich.


⚠ 'A TAPE MEASURE':

  = o'lchov lentasi.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 A camera is something which you take pictures with.
modelAnswers: 1 (e) A camera is something which you take pictures with.
2 (a) An umbrella is something which shelters you from the rain.
3 (d) A fire extinguisher is something which puts out fire.
4 (h) A spoon is something which you eat your soup with.
5 (f) A fan is something which keeps you cool.
6 (g) A tape measure is something which you measure things with.
7 (b) A pair of scissors is something which cuts things.
8 (c) A hanger is something which you hang clothes on.

patterns.formula: ShAHAR + is located + on the ... coast of / in the ... of / in the heart of + MAMLAKAT
patterns.exampleEn: Madrid is located in the heart of Spain. Malaga is located on the south coast of Spain.
patterns.exampleUz: Madrid Ispaniyaning markazida joylashgan. Malaga Ispaniyaning janubiy qirg'og'ida joylashgan.

patterns.formula: A + KASB + is someone who + FE'L(s) ...
patterns.exampleEn: A carpenter is someone who makes things from wood.

patterns.formula: A + NARSA + is something which + (you) + FE'L ... (+ with / on)
patterns.exampleEn: A spoon is something which you eat your soup with. A hanger is something which you hang clothes on.
patterns.exampleUz: Qoshiq - sho'rva ichadigan narsa. Ilgich - kiyim osadigan narsa.
